description: A chess set box sits on a yellow tabletop in front of a red fabric backdrop, with small bagged pieces and a folded board inside. The right hand lifts the box lid up and to the right while the left hand steadies the bottom, then the left hand pulls out a clear bag of pieces as the right hand moves it aside; both hands then grip the folded board, lift it out, rotate it upright, and begin opening it like a book to set it up.
